articles.title: Hannah Nowicki, 94, Tailor
articles.deck: Friends remember Hannah Nowicki for the many years of service to Tannery Flats.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Tannery Flats. Born in Tannery Flats in the years after the war, Hannah Nowicki spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Hannah Nowicki died in September at home on Spring Lane, at the age of 94. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program in his or her name.
